title: Permit bounded maintenance of inherited rejected records in campaign application
body:
Campaign source validator blocks unchanged rejected-record maintenance at inherited mapped paths

Distinct independent review W08-NATIVE-BOUNDARY-002 confirms the native campaign operator refuses three authentic same-path REJECTED-to-REJECTED corrections: Niso4_X_6_H2o, Bacto_Soytone and Na2s2o4. Every candidate preserves its identifier, preferred name and complete prior history. The current category biconditional equates mapped-directory membership with MAPPED status, although native aggregation/export explicitly preserve REJECTED records in that collection.

This is a bounded capability defect, not permission to revive a tombstone, choose a representative or move an ingredient merely to satisfy a path check. Allow only genuine same-path existing-owner edits preserving REJECTED status, identifier and preferred term. Retain all provenance, preimage, schema, history, complete-inventory, owner-chain, receipt and publication guards. Explicitly reject activation, rename/reidentification, relocation, new rejected creations and invalid promotion through this route. Test both the real three targets and their active-family counterparts.

Angustmycin is excluded: its genuine source proposal requires an explicit MAPPED-to-AMBIGUOUS relocation. A same-path exception would not satisfy that obligation. Trypticase soy broth's newly introduced active identity collision is also excluded. Those need their own documented workflow/scientific dispositions.

Independent record-stage probes reveal that REJECTED-to-MAPPED mutations can currently pass in isolation. Do not claim an existing revival refusal; add a real negative as part of the bounded route. No full accepted-plan bypass, source application or production corruption is claimed.

- `data/ingredients/mapped/Niso4_X_6_H2o.yaml`: before `98b56c307ba25d78a1cef9b0773c5b7aaece65b6d811e0130c706d90bcce2289`, reviewed after `5af4d77e4240a5e452ee0760075144d64be40829ec25caf785e5a38ca9772371`.
- `data/ingredients/mapped/Bacto_Soytone.yaml`: before `b9c7e1b675da46d8733749a16b9c56f07618bb63ab5ecd71bdef1bf1cc2d2535`, reviewed after `f242b5c54ac1f1785200c1f604be368d8dabd47ef553164dee8c8e291b6d7a7d`.
- `data/ingredients/mapped/Na2s2o4.yaml`: before `2a370f469e3a425a6f79d1bbada66f77767b8a7fff649951dffaa3ec90145fc5`, reviewed after `569413243139395d50e225efe22b950bd60f5aa3c23ee70d5cfcd002225d1316`.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/native-owner-boundary-design-v1/` and `workers/w08/worktree/.temp/native-application-boundary-independent-v1/`. Exact independent findings snapshot SHA256 `dd40f468b21ee641a30a87d5e20bbad78907632a9b08bf4a3b2c7b7b042b549d`. Native producer SHA256 `4fb9bf0339d4621e56ee4278ae1b68eeadd371d6a7991a4c99ec7ee832670dca`. All original source and role holds remain. No code fix or source application has occurred. Final implementation requires independent adversarial review and real prepare/completed-receipt parity checks.

Live all-state campaign and tombstone searches, plus #1174/#1197 discussions, do not contain this exact native path/status capability defect. Earlier tombstone export/merge issues are different behavior.
